_meta: Aerial's runtime decision points (D1-D12) as understood from the dashboard build (docs/decision-points.md lives in the dashboard repo on the build host, not in this sandbox). Each entry: the decision point, the rule summary, and the BP-KB check ids that measure compliance. Unknown-rule entries are status 'pending' until wired against the authoritative decision-points.md.

D1.name: failure followup classification
D1.rule: Failures are classified R1-R6 by the followup classifier and routed per class; nothing fails silently.

D2.name: model placement: tier policy only
D2.rule: VRAM manager owns displacement/reload; the agent decides only tier policy (Tier A governed, Tier B burst, Tier C attacker). Demand-load failure is a capacity signal, not an agent error — escalate, never hand-stop services.

D3.name: failure flow / mandate state machine
D3.rule: MandateFlow owns scoped failure state transitions per D3; transitions are auditable.

D4.name: pending — authoritative rule lives in decision-points.md
D4.rule: Wire this entry from the dashboard repo's docs/decision-points.md on next build-host access.
